title: Name & address of manufacturer / packer
description: The label must carry the name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer.

title: Country of origin (imported goods)
description: Imported packages must state the country of origin or manufacture.

title: Common or generic name of the commodity
description: The common or generic name of the commodity must be declared.

title: Net quantity in standard units
description: Net quantity must be declared in standard units of weight, measure or number (g, kg, ml, L, N).

title: Month & year of manufacture / packing
description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, packed or imported must be declared.

title: Retail sale price (MRP) declared
description: The maximum retail price must be declared on the package.

title: MRP inclusive of all taxes, in Rs. / ₹
description: MRP must be stated in Indian currency and as inclusive of all taxes.

title: Unit sale price declared
description: Unit sale price (price per kg / L / unit) must accompany the MRP.

title: Consumer care details
description: Name, address, telephone number and e-mail for consumer complaints must be declared.

title: Best before / use-by date
description: Commodities that may become unfit for consumption must state a best before or use-by date.

title: Height of net-quantity numerals
description: Numerals of the net quantity declaration must meet the minimum height for the declared quantity.

title: Legibility & contrast of declarations
description: Declarations must be legible and prominent, contrasting with the background.

title: MRP matches the case record
description: The MRP on the pack must match the MRP recorded for the case / product.

title: Date consistency
description: Manufacture date must not be in the future and best before must fall after manufacture.

title: Evidence image quality
description: The captured image must be sharp, evenly lit and readable for an automated decision.

title: Net quantity matches the declared product
description: The net quantity on the pack must match the quantity recorded for the product under inspection.
